description_en: Queries the statistics information of servers in your assets
description_zh: 查询资产中服务器的统计信息
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-field-statistics --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --machine-types ecs --resource-directory-account-id 12324284232340000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeFieldStatistics

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the server resides
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of asset to query. If you do not specify an asset type, the statistics information of all asset types is queried. Valid values:

ecs: server
cloud_product: cloud product
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的资产类型。不指定资产类型，即查询所有类型资产的统计信息。取值：

ecs：服务器
cloud_product：云产品
parameters.name: machine_types

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account of the member accounts in the resource directory.
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id
